ev-8d0d5db0be.rationale: The value has no ':' between the numeric id and the secret (missing-delimiter twin: the ':' removed; underscore twin: the ':' replaced by '_'). Telegram's Bot API server source, which the Bot API documentation names as the server source code, answers 401 'invalid token specified' to any token that contains no ':' (ClientManager::send), so such a string is not a token that server accepts; the step from that check to these values is a search for ':' that a reviewer can repeat. Limits: this is published server source, not prose documentation, and no page read states that api.telegram.org runs identical code; the check does not state a token grammar. Negative twin: exactly one structural property (the delimiter) differs from its positive; silence follows from construction.

sources.supports: ClientManager::send rejects with 401 'Unauthorized: invalid token specified' when token.find(':') == npos (also when the token starts with '0', exceeds 80 characters or contains '/'), at the commit pinned in the source record.
The Bot API documentation states that the Bot API server source code is available at https://github.com/tdlib/telegram-bot-api, the repository cited as the provider's server source.

ev-8af4d9797e.rationale: Consistency only. After the colon the value has no body (prefix-only '123456:'), a 3-character body ('abc'), or a 4-character run of body characters before a second colon (the log line '1727172000:INFO:telegram.ext...'). Four open-source rule artifacts from different maintainers (gitleaks, trufflehog, detect-secrets, Nosey Parker) all require at least 34 contiguous body characters directly after the colon, so all three values are outside all four grammars. Worded as consistency with these artifacts, not as a Telegram rule: no Telegram page read states a token alphabet or length (the documentation gives only illustrative examples, whose bodies are 34 characters). Whether the rules were written independently of one another is not established. Scanner output on this fixture and agreement among scanners are not used. Malformed-by-construction control: expected silence follows from construction.

sources.supports: Rule telegram-bot-api-token (v8.30.1) value grammar: [0-9]{5,16} then a colon, then a literal capital A and 34 more characters in [a-z0-9_-] (case-insensitive), a 35-character body starting with A. The rule's 'telegr' keyword requirement is a context condition and is not relied on here.
